recommended_order: Implement deterministic KETO_FLOW_GATE reference head with exact work accounting and drain semantics.
Implement CONSTITUTION_BOUND_OPTIMIZER over frozen synthetic operational traces only.
Add negative tests proving neither timing nor optimizer score can modify evidence/authority/mass-effect.
Add an executable blinded reviewer/disagreement gate using Fast-CAT method patterns.
Freeze a latency/resource benchmark before claiming any speed improvement.

established: The three source repositories contain bounded engineering patterns relevant to DemiHead design when their source-domain claims are quarantined.
janus-io-public documents reproducible flow segmentation in its tested PoW process; only the admission/drain pattern is proposed for cross-domain reuse.
Janus-Demiurge contains an ordinary GP/EI ask/tell/history optimization implementation alongside speculative legacy heuristics; only the ordinary optimization pattern is admitted for local redesign.
Fast-CAT documents fail-closed blinded-review and disagreement-preservation patterns already represented in KETO lineage.
The current DemiHead tree lacks dedicated executable flow-gate, constitution-bound optimizer and reviewer-bundle ingestion heads.
